findings_and_relationships.classification: new source-derived conditional planner projection mismatch; no observed gameplay state or rendering
findings_and_relationships.first_contract: Native case-site start stores the outbound active leg, its forecast camp intervals and elapsed time only. The camp template treats a case-site destination as a round trip, passes outbound-plus-return movement total to the planner and synthesizes persisted movement up to twice the outbound duration inside the stored outbound elapsed time. The client positions both the quest turnaround and the return End on this mixed representation.
findings_and_relationships.conditions: An active journey to a case site reaches camp with a remaining walking interval and its camp page receives a stored journey. For outbound movement A, a synthetic trailing walking interval ending at 2A is compressed into the native outbound-only elapsed interval; if an independently stored return B differs from A, another field instead says A+B. Client interpolation may place the quest/return markers before the corresponding active-leg arrival. This is symbolic source reasoning, not an observed user session, runtime, actual asymmetric route, or claim the stored authority moves a character incorrectly.
findings_and_relationships.safeguards: Native case-site route admission validates outgoing and independently planned return; a later return starts its own active journey. Map pre-departure round-trip forecasting is a separate intended view. Preserve camp status, actual-versus-forecast boundaries and correct duration authority.
findings_and_relationships.relationship: q1002 records a broader return-route and timing policy question; old strategic calendar assessment previously read travel.rs:455–548 at c100 but did not establish this active-leg-to-display mismatch. Current 059 identities and prior assessments searched without exact alias found. The neighboring mirrored terrain case is a distinct transformation in the same planner family.
findings_and_relationships.future_repair_direction: After the audit gate, define whether the camp timeline represents the actual active leg or a separate full round-trip projection; compute movement, elapsed, return route and markers coherently from the same declared authority, including independently timed return legs.

findings_and_relationships.conditions: Camp page has a nonempty valid outward and return terrain path, a case-site destination, positive total/turnaround and itinerary walking segments. Source shows two representations, but no actual route data, rendered overlay, accessibility output or consumer runtime has been observed.
